name: fullstack-intern-task
description: Layora, a Mini SaaS Template Store. React + Vite client and Express + MongoDB API.
author: Shanmugam R <shanmugamrskfamily@gmail.com>

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
